title: Find charter schools in California where the free meal eligibility rate for
question: Find charter schools in California where the free meal eligibility rate for students aged 5–17 is higher than the lowest SAT excellence rate across all schools. Return the school name, city, and charter number.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s."XCL_047", s."XCL_050", s."XCL_064"
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
WHERE s."XCL_063" = 1
  AND CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" > (
      SELECT MIN(CAST("XCL_040" AS REAL) / "XCL_036")
      FROM satscores
      WHERE "XCL_036" > 0
  )
